|game_text=Deploy on a Rebel Base war room. Echo Base Operations is canceled. Your ability-1 permanent pilots aboard T-47s, X-wings, Y-wings, and Z-95s (except squadrons) are replaced by ability-2 permanent pilots who add 1 to power. During your control phase, may retrieve one [[Y-wing]] or Z-95. Suspended if opponent controls this site. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the image is the Players Committee card image (the release-sheet slip is the second image). The later errata version is [[Incom Corporation & •Koensayr Manufacturing (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> and the revised copy (20 April 2010)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1-revised">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], revised copy (PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a Rebel Base war room. Echo Base Operations is canceled. Your ability-1 permanent pilots aboard T-47s, X-wings, Y-wings, and Z-95s (except squadrons) are replaced by ability-2 permanent pilots who add 1 to power. During your control phase, may retrieve one Y-wing or Z-95. Suspended if opponent controls this site. [Immune to Alter]” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-80-Incom_Corporation_Koensayr_Manufacturing.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-incomcorporation&koensayrmanufacturing-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 25) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Incom Corporation & •Koensayr Manufacturing (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) dropped “Echo Base Operations is canceled.”<ref name="cl-1261_81-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy on a Rebel Base war room. Your ability-1 permanent pilots aboard T-47s, X-wings, Y-wings, and Z-95s (except squadrons) are replaced by ability-2 permanent pilots who add 1 to power. During your control phase, may retrieve one Y-wing or Z-95. Suspended if opponent controls this site. (Immune to Alter.)” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-80-Incom_Corporation_Koensayr_Manufacturing-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
